annotations.description: GPT52 Vet targeted themselves with Burst Lightning, dealing 2 damage to themselves (going from 6 to 4 life) instead of targeting Haiku Worrier who is at 4 life. Burst Lightning deals 2 damage to any target, and the opponent is at exactly 4 life. While 2 damage doesn't kill the opponent outright, targeting the opponent puts them to 2 life and creates massive pressure, whereas targeting yourself is pure self-harm with no benefit whatsoever. Even better, targeting Ral, Crackling Wit (at 5 loyalty) would remove 2 loyalty counters. But the most egregious error is choosing to damage yourself.

annotations.description: GPT52 Vet targeted themselves with Burst Lightning, dealing 2 damage to themselves when they are at 6 life and the opponent is at 4 life. Burst Lightning deals 2 damage to any target - targeting the opponent (Haiku Worrier) at 4 life would deal 2 damage, bringing them to 2 life. Even better, targeting Ral, Crackling Wit (which has 6 loyalty) would remove some loyalty counters, though the opponent at 4 life is the more pressing target. Dealing 2 damage to yourself when you're at 6 life and your opponent is at 4 life is catastrophic - it puts you closer to death while missing the chance to bring the opponent to 2 life (within range of almost any burn spell).
